Type: global print throw pillow
Use: on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, rustic, contemporary
Materials: printed textured cotton-look fabric
Colors: charcoal grey, off-white
Shape: square, all-over block-print tribal motifs in a patchwork layout, faded stamped look, knife edges, large
Feel: earthy, relaxed, casual
Goes with: neutrals, linen, natural wood, black accents; bohemian, farmhouse or modern rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Casual Global Throw Pillow - 20 x 20 Inch, Charcoal
product.description: Made in the United States and imported The beautiful pattern on this casual throw pillow is inspired by block printing, giving it an appearance similar to ink on paper. A solid charcoal back completes the aesthetic. 20"L x 20"W This pillow features a block print-inspired pattern for a classic global look. Back of pillow is solid gray-colored fabric. Hidden zipper at bottom of pillow. Pillow cover and insert Spot clean. Pillow insert arrives in vacuum sealed bag. Carefully remove insert from packaging and let it fully expand before putting inside of pillow cover.
